entries.0cb85b81e0631635: The company was established in June 2014 in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and its origins lie in an English school that its representative director and president, Kenzaburo Ikushima, opened while still a university student. The company was listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in June 2023, and as of May 31, 2026, it had 49 employees and no affiliated companies.
entries.10e982853978ff0d: Its three strengths are a platform of more than 1,400 popular teaching titles assembled through licensing agreements with publishers, ease of use through more than 40 learning functions specialized in English, and AI recommendations based on more than 3.4 billion answer data items together with real-time score prediction. The organic user acquisition rate, which does not rely on advertising, has reached about 91%.

entries.3045b86b5a3a38f1: It is a subscription-based English learning platform centered on the paid plan (Pro Plan). It also sells some content individually. Only the subscription share of revenue is disclosed; no separate amount is disclosed.
